description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) class 'LeaveTypeDao' for managing leave type data in an HR management system. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, deleting, undeleting, and searching leave types, interacting with the database via query builders, and referencing other related entities such as 'LeaveType' and 'LeaveRequest'.

classes.name: LeaveTypeDao
classes.description: DAO class for interacting with LeaveType entities, providing methods for CRUD operations, fuzzy search, and validation related to leave types.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeList
methods.description: Retrieve a list of all non-deleted LeaveType records, ordered by name.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeById
methods.description: Fetch a LeaveType entity by its primary key ID.

methods.name: getExistingLeaveTypeIds
methods.description: Retrieve IDs of leave types from a given list that currently exist and are not marked as deleted.

methods.name: saveLeaveType
methods.description: Persist a LeaveType entity to the database.

methods.name: deleteLeaveType
methods.description: Mark specified leave types as deleted based on their IDs.

methods.name: getDeletedLeaveTypeList
methods.description: Retrieve a list of leave types marked as deleted.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeByName
methods.description: Find a leave type that matches a specific name, if not deleted.

methods.name: undeleteLeaveType
methods.description: Restore a previously deleted leave type to active status.

methods.name: searchLeaveType
methods.description: Search for leave types based on filter parameters with pagination support.

methods.name: getSearchLeaveTypePaginator
methods.description: Construct and return a paginator for searching leave types based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchLeaveTypesCount
methods.description: Get the count of leave types matching search filter parameters.

methods.name: hasEmployeeAllocatedLeavesForLeaveType
methods.description: Check if an employee has any allocated leave requests for a specific leave type.
